crossRefs.note: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.

The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…

But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I…

Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
translations.bsb: But the scribes and Pharisees were filled with rage and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
translations.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
